tags.feature: Added a new boss known as Minamoto, who will also be incorporated into other areas of the game as a regular enemy once he is defeated;

Added a new cut-scene where Jorogumo devours Chisai;
Added a new cut-scene where Chisai falls from the roof into Jorogumo’s lake;
Added unique cinematics whenever Takeshi dies due to the ceiling spike trap, floor spike trap, or the guillotine trap.
Added a new cinematic to introduce the Minamoto boss.

tags.balance_change: Improved the AI for Sojobo and made the boss fight more difficult;
Improved the AI for both boss fights with Shuten-dōji;
Changed the Mother Spider boss fight so that she doesn’t spit out more than 4 spiders at a time.

tags.bug: The speed at which she spits them out has also been fixed and a new VFX has been added to her spitting.

tags.balance_change: The spit will also now damage the player if they’re in range;
Improve the AI for the spider enemies in the Cave levels, particularly when they navigate between hanging from the ceiling and moving to the ground;
Improved the AI for the Tengu, Archer, Undead, and Slave enemies;
Removed the camera rotation effect when moving;
Changed the health system so that you now cannot lose two lives in a row.

tags.feature: Added a visual effect whenever you lose a life so it is more obvious when it has happened;
Added a visual parry time indicator to enemies’ attack animations;
Added a visual indicator whenever a parry is successful;
Added a reward for a successful parry, where enemies will not be able to defend themselves for a period of time;

tags.balance_change: Changed how kunai work so they have different effects depending on their type.
Changed the Tengu enemy type so it doesn’t recover energy during combat;
Changed the way enemy armour works so it will now serve as a cover against attacks during combat;
Changed the Combo Editor so selecting assigned moves will highlight them in the list;

tags.feature: Added a button in the Combo Editor to reset to default combos;

tags.balance_change: Improved hit boxes for all enemies;

tags.feature: Added a transparency effect when passing the foreground columns of the Fortress level;

tags.balance_change: Smoothed the slow motion effect;

tags.feature: Added an option to disable controller vibration in the game menu;

tags.balance_change: Optimized the game further so that most levels will now run at a stable 60fps;
Changed how check points work so they have to be activated by interacting with them, rather than being triggered automatically;

tags.feature: Added checkpoints before every boss fight and balanced out the number of checkpoints throughout the game;
Added automatic checkpoints to the start of some levels to prevent blockers;

tags.balance_change: Made the loading icon larger;
Changed the VFX for the spider enemies;

tags.feature: Added an independent volume control for cut-scenes and cinematics.
Added default settings to the Steam Deck build;

tags.balance_change: Optimized the game on Steam Deck so that it should now achieve a stable 60fps across all levels;
Adapted any text featured across the entire game (including UI, dialogue, etc.) to ensure they’re legible on the Steam Deck.

tags.bug: Fixed the issue that caused the camera to start shaking when the player dies;
Fixed an issue where some enemies would take cover when hit from behind;
Fixed the camera jumping when turning during gameplay;

notes.title: The Journey So Far
notes.content:
[h3]The path of the warrior always comes with obstacles and battles to be won, but the resulting peace is worth the fight.

We wanted to share with you our development journey so far and give you all a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon for The Spirit of the Samurai![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165389/8547d8f65d70ed0d36e022be7766949d6120e221.png[/img]

Since our launch on December 12th 2024, our small team has continued to work steadily and very hard on The Spirit of the Samurai to improve the gameplay experience by listening to your feedback and suggestions, as well as adding new features and content. We’re extremely grateful to everyone who has taken the time to submit bug reports and give their feedback, which has helped us to make these updates and plan for the future of the game!

We’ve released two major updates so far, which came with quality of life improvements, balancing, improved combat controls, optimization of Steam Deck performance, a whole new cut-scene, and lots of bug fixes. If you want to know everything that was included in these updates, you can check out our patch notes for the first one [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1507120/announcements/detail/505063832286134498]here[/url][/b] and the second one [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1507120/announcements/detail/534338967351329415]here[/url][/b].

So what does the road ahead look like for The Spirit of the Samurai?

We’re working on a third update at the moment, which will include a new enemy and brand new death cinematics! On top of that, we’ll also be adding more depth to the combo system, implementing more player feedback, and more bug fixes. 

After that, we plan to update the game regularly as soon as we have new improvements ready. All of these updates and all of the new content will be free for all players. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507120/The_Spirit_of_the_Samurai/

[h3]Please do not hesitate to send us your suggestions and comments, since we’re listening to you and want your feedback for the future of the game!

Together we will make an even better game. Thank you for your help and trust!

You can submit your feedback in our Steam Forum or follow the links below to let us know on Discord and social media 🦊[/h3]

notes.title: Patch #2: Steam Deck Performance Improvements and Even More Optimization!
notes.content:
We’re excited to let you all know that we’ve released our second patch for The Spirit of the Samurai!

Thank you once again for all of the players who have submitted their feedback and provided us with bug reports. We wouldn’t have been able to do this without your help!

Here are the major changes we’ve implemented in this patch:
[list]
[*] Regenerated all videos for the cut-scenes to Webm format, which is fully compatible with the Steam Deck and all other systems. This has eliminated all performance issues related to the cut-scenes on Steam Deck.
[*] Optimised performance on Steam Deck and lower spec PCs for increased stability and frame-rate (average 60 FPS).	
[*] Adjusted the visibility of the combo panel to better display on Steam Deck and smaller monitors.
[*] Improved the AI of the Undead enemies.
[*] Added new climbing points to the Tower level when you play as Chisai (the kitten).
[*] Combat balancing for Takeshi, particularly with the strength of his strikes.
[*] Improved controls during combat. Certain actions, such as the roll, can now be interrupted early so that players can attack if necessary. 
[*] Reduced VRAM usage (around 1.2GB) in the final fight and Kodama cave scene.
[*] Adjusted the hitboxes of Takeshi’s strikes so they’re more accurate. 
[*] Added a new cutscene featuring the Slave enemy type in the Dungeon level.
[*] General bug fixing.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507120/The_Spirit_of_the_Samurai/

We’re still going to be gathering bug reports and feedback to form the basis for future patches, but we hope you enjoy the new and improved performance of The Spirit of the Samurai in this patch!

If you do encounter any bugs or would like to share any feedback with us, we’d love to hear from you in the Steam Forums, in our Discord, or on social media 🦊

notes.title: Patch #1: Combat Improvements, Performance Optimization, and Much More!
notes.content:
First of all, we’d like to say a huge thank you to all of the players who have taken the time to provide feedback and submit bug reports on The Spirit of the Samurai!

Your help has been invaluable when it has come to diagnosing the bugs that needed fixing and deciding on what quality of life changes to include in our first patch.

Thanks to you all, here are the major changes we’ve made in Build 1.0.06 based on player feedback:

[list]
[*] [b]Responsiveness of Combat & Other Controls:[/b] We’ve improved combat and general movement controls to create a more fluid and consistent player experience. Parries are easier to execute effectively and the player character can now perform other actions while drinking potions or picking up items, so players can defend themselves more easily from incoming enemies. 
[*] [b]Animation Speed:[/b] Character animations for the parry, item pick-up, and drinking health potions have been sped up.
[*] [b]Level Navigation Improvements:[/b] The camera will now zoom out when players are navigating through the platforms in the Forest and Dungeon level, so that players have increased visibility when navigating the path ahead and jumping between platforms.
[*] [b]Checkpoints & Shrines:[/b] We’ve added more checkpoints during the Basement, Forest, Cemetery, and Dungeon levels. We’ve also made it so that Shrines will function as checkpoints as well, meaning your game will now save after you’ve used the Shrine. We have also reduced the time it takes to offer items at the Shrine.
[*] [b]Boss Balancing:[/b] We have balanced the bosses and made boss fights more challenging.
[*] [b]Ranged Attacks:[/b] Archers and other ranged enemies will no longer attack you if they are off-screen.  
[*] [b]Steam Deck Performance:[/b] We’ve improved performance of the game on the Steam Deck and have managed to achieve a consistent 90+ FPS in most areas. There are a few areas where players may still experience frame rate issues, but overall performance on the Steam Deck has improved considerably.
[*] [b]4K Resolution:[/b] The bug causing black bars to appear around the screen in 4K resolution has been fixed, so you can enjoy The Spirit of the Samurai in the full glory of 4K!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507120/The_Spirit_of_the_Samurai/

We’re still working on other quality of life changes, performance improvements, and bug fixes based on the feedback you’ve given us, but we hope that these changes will significantly enhance your experience of The Spirit of the Samurai!

If you do encounter any bugs or would like to share any feedback with us, we’d love to hear from you in the Steam Forums, in our Discord, or on social media 🦊
